sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} bearded seal was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Bearded seals live in Arctic and sub-Arctic waters with sea ice and feed mostly on the sea floor.
His farthest point from the start came on {farthest_date}, {max_displacement_km} away, and his daily positions add up to {path_km}.
There is one long silence in his record: {longest_gap_days}.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
